meta.title: To-do list
meta.description: An Apple Reminders-style to-do list in the right sidebar, stored locally and shared across every conversation, readable and editable by the model via personal_todos. Features a collapsible two-pane layout: a sidebar with live search, 6 Smart Lists (Today with Morning/Afternoon/Tonight sections, Scheduled, All, Flagged, Urgent, Completed), Pinned Lists, a Suggested Groceries list, Recently Deleted (30-day soft delete & recovery), #Tags filtering, and custom My Lists with colors, icons, and sections; plus an inline task editor and quick-action pill bar for date, time (HH:MM), urgent alarm, repeat recurrence, location, #tags, flag, subtasks, URL, priority, list/section assignment, and a ⓘ Inspector. Stored in ~/.dsh/dsh-apple-reminders/todos.json and kept in two-way sync with Apple Reminders on macOS (distinguishing all-day vs timed reminders, supporting list moves and multi-list sync, resolving conflicts in DSH favour, rebuilding deleted Reminders lists, and pruning tasks completed over 30 days ago from Reminders while keeping DSH history). Turning the plugin off keeps the file.
